title: Ape Mod
body: This mod is not for the weak. This mod was created with the intention of giving the world a challenge only the worthy would be able to handle. Only people with a **high tolerance** for simians are allowed to experience this Minecraft modification. This mod adds a ***lot*** of apes, for example: the Chimp block, the Chimp fluid, Chimp of life, Chimp of arrow, Music Munky, et cetera. These monkeys require a lot of crafting to acquire, and I'm not sure you're up for the challenge. Prove me wrong, or die trying.
